record.paper_title: Ten Conferences WORDS: Open Problems and Conjectures
record.original_question: Explore the applications of the probabilistic method in the scope of pattern avoidance.

evidence.quote: Explore the applications of the probabilistic method in the scope of pattern avoidance.

artifact.status_search_result: The question is a broad open-ended research direction rather than a single conjecture. Probabilistic methods (notably the Lovász Local Lemma and entropy compression) have been successfully applied to pattern avoidance (e.g., work by Grytczuk, Kozik, Micek, and others on nonrepetitive sequences and Thue-type results), but the program of systematically applying the probabilistic method across pattern avoidance remains active and incomplete; many specific avoidability indices, repetition thresholds, and growth-rate questions remain open.

status_evidence.title: An introduction to the probabilistic method through the Lovász Local Lemma
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of probabilistic-method applications including nonrepetitive sequences and pattern avoidance.
status_evidence.claim: Probabilistic-method techniques such as LLL and entropy compression are an active toolkit applied to pattern avoidance problems, with many directions still open.
